visualCharacteristics: Repeating look-alike cards (image, title, text, link to a detail page) in a scroller -> Cards. | Dynamic news list: each item links to a detail article with a date-bound teaser -> Cards.
contentPattern: White teaser cards: image, title, dotted separator, description, "En savoir plus →" link; horizontal scroller. | Same card design as Nos boutiques (image, title, description, "En savoir plus →"); reuses cards-teaser.
usage: One row per card: cell 1 image, cell 2 heading (h3/h4), description paragraph and a final standalone link ("En savoir plus"). The title is linked to the same target when not linked by the author. Rendered as a horizontal scroller.
reuseGuidance: Use for shop, news or editorial teasers (Nos boutiques, Legallais pour vous). For logo-only tiles use cards-logos.
